document:216.text:
Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Greetings! I'm a maid at the palace, but I doubt you'd know who I am... After all, there are so many people around, and I've never had the chance to speak with you. But I just wanted to say… I've always looked up to you! No, not just that! I think you're incredible, charming, and… honestly, really good-looking.

(Oh no, I don't know what I'm writing...)

Your Highness, you're a blessing from the Queen—of course, you're the Queen's son. I mean, you remind me of the moon in the night sky, shining gently from far above... Ugh, forget it, I'm really not great with words. The point is, I like you a lot!

I hope this letter won't be burned! I'd be so grateful if you could just take a quick look at it... Ugh...

(I'm not making any sense... Let me start over!)
document:216.source_cn:
尊敬的沙利叶殿下：

呃……您好！我是宫里的侍女……嗯，当然您肯定不认识我，宫里人那么多，我平时也没机会说话的。可是，可是！我一直都很敬仰您！不，不只是敬仰！是觉得您……呃，很厉害，很高贵，也……很好看。
（天啊，我在写什么……）

殿下！您就像女王的恩典，呃，不对，您本来就是女王之子……您就像夜晚的月亮，又温柔又高远！啊不，您其实比月亮还……呃……算了，总之，我很喜欢您！
希望这封信不要被烧掉！要是您能看看就好……呃……

（我究竟在写什么语无伦次的东西……我还是再写一封吧！）

document:217.text:
Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Please forgive my audacity in writing this letter. I know I'm too insignificant for you to read my words, but I have to write them down anyway to express my thoughts.

From the moment you strode past me in the grand hall, I realized that some lights were too bright to go unnoticed. Your presence commanded admiration, your grace was unmatched, and your gaze... it took my breath away.

(Is this too much?)

Don't worry, I'm not expecting anything from you. Just know that you have a secret admirer out there... I hope this letter doesn't get thrown away!

(Is this too cringey? People don't write their love letters like this nowadays... Let me think it over again!)
document:217.source_cn:
尊敬的沙利叶殿下：

请原谅我的僭越，我知道自己微不足道，或许这封信永远不会被拆开，但若不写下这些字句，我的心绪便无处安放。

自您在王宫大殿中步履而过的那一刻起，我便明白，有些光芒即便不直视，也能在心头留下痕迹。您的气度令人敬仰，您的身姿如此优雅，而您的目光……您的目光令我屏息。
（这会不会太浮夸了……？）

总之，我不敢奢求什么，只是想让您知道，这个世界上，有人一直默默注视着您，敬仰您……希望这封信不会被丢掉！

（会不会太煽情了……现在已经不流行这种情书写法了……我再想想！）

document:218.text:
Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Although the palace is always bustling, I'm used to keeping to myself, fulfilling my role as a maid. However, every time you pass by, the noise around me fades, and my gaze is inevitably drawn to your presence.

I wasn't in a place to write this letter, yet I did, driven by the desire to let my feelings leave a trace—even if only as ink on paper. Whether it's burned to ash or forgotten, it doesn't matter. I don't expect you to notice me, but if one day you happen to read this, I hope you'll spare a thought for me—someone who has quietly admired you from afar. That alone would be enough.

<align="right">From a maid who admires you</align>
document:218.source_cn:
尊敬的沙利叶殿下：

王宫中总是繁忙喧嚣，而我也习惯了在角落里静静做事，谨慎、不多言，恪守侍女的本分。然而，每当您经过，周围的喧闹仿佛都会消失片刻，我的目光也总会在那一瞬间不受控制地停留。

我并不该写下这封信，但我仍然写了，因为我想让这份心意留下痕迹，哪怕只是纸上的笔迹，哪怕最终落入火中，化作微尘。我不敢奢望被您注意，但若有一天，您偶然间读到这封信，能在某个夜晚想起，曾有人在遥远的角落里，默默怀揣着对您的敬慕，那便足够了。

<align="right">—— 一名敬仰您的侍女</align>
